prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, preserving its exact silhouettes, object positions, sizes, gaps, and orthographic views. Output ONE transparent PNG, 3:4 canvas, preferably 1536x2048. The guide is the edit target; design_reference.png is the approved material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is the original colour reference (magenta is background, never paint magenta).
The guide has three columns by FOUR rows of equal 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 repeat the SAME five views: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Preserve all views exactly, including pairs where shown; do not redraw, enlarge, move or redesign objects.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of tall soft rust-red suede boots reaching up the calf, with a row of four small square gold buttons on short leather straps down the outer side, soft rounded toes and a thin dark sole. Match the reference details and original icon colours. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls if present follow the design reference scaled to each view. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. #FF0000 for ALL metal including gold buttons; #00FF00 for ALL leather including straps, suede, padding, hide and fur; #0000FF for cloth including linings, cords, ribbons and hair; #FFFF00 for matte non-metal solids including wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax. Every pixel inside each silhouette must get exactly one of these colours. For these boots the leather bodies and leather straps are pure green, gold button parts pure red. Keep material locations consistent with the painted upper views.
Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent. Nothing outside the silhouettes. Column 3 of rows 2 and 4 must remain empty and transparent. No ground, outlines, text, glow, sparkles, aura or background. Change only surface paint within the guide silhouettes.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: the material mask must be clean isolated hard-edged silhouettes, with absolutely NO green spill, spray, speckles, haze, or colour outside the original guide objects. Background between every object and cell remains entirely transparent. Top-view boot openings stay transparent in both paint and masks. Exact guide contours are mandatory. Do not flood-fill background or gaps. Flat green is confined precisely to leather surfaces.
